item.title: China Rolls Out J-35AE Stealth Jet As F-35 Rival, Pak May Be First Buyer

item.description: The Pentagon addressed claims of Iran's use of "kamikaze dolphins" in the Hormuz Strait, though details of their response were not provided. The US military has been scrutinizing such reports amid heightened tensions with Iran.

item.title: Vietnam major pillar of India’s Act East Policy, says Modi
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Modi stated that Vietnam is a major pillar of India's Act East Policy. This was in a meeting with To Lam, General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam and current Vietnamese President.

item.title: India, Algeria hold first joint defence commission meet
item.description: India and Algeria held their first joint defence commission meeting, signing the Rules of Procedure to guide their defence cooperation. This aims to streamline collaboration mechanisms between the two countries.

item.title: Oil prices drop and stock markets rise after reports of deal to end Iran war
item.description: Oil prices dropped and stock markets rose following reports of a potential deal to end the Iran war. These developments raised hopes of an agreement between the US and Iran after days of escalation.

item.title: Ted Turner, media mogul who revolutionised TV news by launching CNN, dies at 87
item.description: Ted Turner, media mogul, died at 87. He pioneered modern 24-hour news culture with the launch of CNN in 1980, transforming the television news landscape. The media mogul pioneered the modern 24-hour news culture when he launched the Cable News Network in 1980.
